chunks: Abu Basir said to him: “I hear a sneeze, so I praise Allah, Exalted is He, and I send blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم while I am in salat (prayer).”
He said: “Yes, even if there is a sea between you and your companion.”

key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْيَمُّ: the sea; a metaphor for great distance

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to praise Allah and send blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم during salat when hearing someone sneeze?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates the permissibility of praising Allah and sending blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم during salat (prayer) upon hearing a sneeze. The Imam عليه السلام affirms this without restriction, even when the sneezer is far away.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1058 - Abu Basir said to him:
"I hear someone sneeze, and I praise Allah (swt) and send blessings upon the Prophet (sw) while I am in prayer."
Imam (as) said: "Yes, even if there is a sea between you and your companion."
